selectors_yml:
selectors:
  - name: staging_only
    description: Only the staging layer (models and their tests).
    definition:
      method: path
      value: models/staging

  - name: nightly
    description: The nightly job - every finance or marketing mart, with all its parents.
    definition:
      union:
        - method: tag
          value: finance
          parents: true
        - method: tag
          value: marketing
          parents: true

  - name: finance_marts
    description: Finance models that live in the marts folder (intersection).
    definition:
      intersection:
        - method: tag
          value: finance
        - method: path
          value: models/marts

  - name: no_python
    description: Everything except the Python model.
    definition:
      union:
        - method: fqn
          value: "*"
        - exclude:
            - method: fqn
              value: customer_segments
